SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_common.risk_weight_config
AND status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_common.risk_weight_config (config_name, supply_chain_weight, transaction_weight, material_weight, low_risk_threshold, mid_risk_threshold, high_risk_threshold, status, version, maker_id) VALUES (#{configName}, #{supplyChainWeight}, #{transactionWeight}, #{materialWeight}, #{lowRiskThreshold}, #{midRiskThreshold}, #{highRiskThreshold}, #{status}, #{version}, #{makerId})
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_common.risk_weight_config SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_common.material_checklist_template (business_type, required_materials, version, status, maker_id) VALUES (#{businessType}, CAST(#{requiredMaterials, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{version}, #{status}, #{makerId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_common.material_checklist_template ORDER BY business_type
